benefits.title: A small step for the child, clear visibility for the parent

items.title: Short, focused sessions
items.desc: A session has at most 10 questions. Your child can start and finish without getting tired, and pick up where they left off the next day.

items.title: The reasoning behind the answer
items.desc: A step-by-step solution appears after every answer. A wrong answer is not an end, it is a chance to read the explanation.

items.title: A topic summary parents can read
items.desc: See how many questions were solved in each subject and which topics should be reviewed, all on one screen.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.desc: A student account is created. Parents can connect to the app to track their child's progress.

steps.title: The child does short sessions
steps.desc: Pick a subject and topic, solve questions, read the explanations. Questions answered wrongly return to the review list the next day.

steps.title: The parent sees the topic summary
steps.desc: The parent panel shows questions solved per subject, the correct rate and review suggestions.

report.title: What does the parent report look like?
report.desc: We do not show a percentage until enough questions are solved. A firm result from little data would be misleading.
report.disclaimer: This report does not belong to a real student; it is an example prepared to show how the screen looks.
report.reviewText: Mathematics · Place value: 2 questions wrong, review recommended.

trust.title: What we can say today
trust.desc: We only write things that really exist in the app.

items.title: Ad-free by default
items.desc: Ads are off by default in the student app, and the app does not ask for location permission.

items.title: No data reaches the parent panel without consent
items.desc: The parent gives consent for the child's study data to appear in the parent panel and can withdraw it at any time.

items.title: The answer key is not kept on the child's device
items.desc: The correct answer stays on the server until the question is checked.

items.title: Honest scope
items.desc: We do not promise exam success or score gains. Hupo is designed to support regular practice and make review needs visible.

plans.title: Plans
plans.cardDesc: When price and scope are settled they will appear here and in your parent account. We do not publish unconfirmed prices or trial periods.
bullets: No payment requested before the price is final
Updates also appear in your parent account

items.a: Our first focus is preparation for the move from 4th to 5th grade. The grade and subject coverage in the app is expanding during the pilot.

items.q: Do I need an account for the sample questions?
items.a: No. You can try the sample questions without creating an account; your answers are not saved.

items.q: Are these real school exam questions?
items.a: No. The questions are examples written for Hupo based on the relevant grade's learning outcomes. They are not presented as official school exam questions.

items.q: How do I set up an account for my child?
items.a: A parent account is created first, then the student account is linked to it.

items.q: What happens after a wrong answer?
items.a: The child sees the step-by-step solution. Questions answered wrongly are added to the review list the next day.
No. Hupo supports preparation; admission depends on each school's own conditions.
The paid plan is being prepared. When plans are settled they will be shown on this page and in your parent account.

items.q: How do I manage my child's data?
items.a: Consent for the child's study data to appear in the parent panel is given from the parent panel and can be withdrawn from the same place.
